system.description:
You have learned to enter the aggressive and fast paced Wolf Fang fighting stance. You fight with both hands as claws. Each strike aiming for a creature sensitive organs attempting to cause bludgeoning damage on each strike.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6.

As an action, you perform the Wolf Fang Fist.

Wolf Fang Fist. Make two unarmed attacks, increasing your [Unarmed Damage] die by +1.

Beginning at 5th level, As part of using Wolf Fang Fist, before making any attacks, you let out a battle cry. All allied creatures within 30 feet of you that can hear you gain a +1 bonus to their next attack roll or saving throw, whichever comes first, which lasts until the start of your next turn.

Beginning at 10th level, Wolf Fang Fist now makes three unarmed attacks instead of two and the battle cry bonus increases to +2. If you reduce a creature to 0 hit points as a result of these attacks, the bonus lasts until the end of each allies creatures turns.

activities.label: Wolf Fang Fist
activities.text: 5th: battle cry, allies within 30 ft get +1 (10th: +2) to their next attack or save.
